title: Gate, Do Once, Flip Flop and Register keep run-scoped node state

behaviour.expect: Inspecting a live run exposes one run-scoped slot for each of nodes 2, 3, 4 and 5, addressed by node ID, with readable current values (flip-flop is_a, do-once fired flag, gate is_open, register current). Reading the slots does not change them and executes no node.

deferred.reason: Run-state inspection/checkpoint harness is not defined; the graph and reset trace exist separately.

behaviour.expect: A checkpoint taken from a run of this graph (opt-in, persistent variables only) contains none of the slots of nodes 2, 3, 4 and 5. Restoring that checkpoint into a new run leaves all four slots at their initial state (node state is never persisted in v1).

deferred.reason: Run-state inspection/checkpoint harness is not defined; the graph and reset trace exist separately.
